tei:titleStmt.tei:title: mgon po'i tshogs 'bum 'bul skabs/tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa sha
mgon po'i tshogs 'bum 'bul skabs/tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa sha

tei:div.tei:p: mgon po'i tshogs 'bum 'bul skabs/ tshogs rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can chang zung la yaṃ dang*/ mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed bu ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ dum bu gcig pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de'i dbus su mu las dri chu baiḍūr+ya lta bu/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor ra las rak+ta gser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las klad pa/ slar yang dbus su na las mi'i sha /shar lhor go las ba lang gi sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las glang po che'i sha /byang shar du ha las rta'i sha /de rnams slar yang yi ge de dag gis mtshan pa'o// rang gi sna bug g.yon pa nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod pas rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po 'di/ rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa ā li kā li/

mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di/ bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ byin brlab kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi/ ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ lan gsum/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig bla ma rnams zhengs shig /bka' brgyud bla ma sku bskyod 'tshal// rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig yi dam rnams zhengs shig /rdo rje phag mo sku bskyod 'tshal// o rgyan gnas nas gshegs su gsol// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams zhengs shig /dpal ldan mgon po sku bskyod 'tshal// ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams zhengs shig /sras mchog nag po sku bskyod 'tshal// las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams zhengs shig /'jig rten mgon po sku bskyod 'tshal// 'jig rten mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams zhengs shig /dam can rgya mtsho sku bskyod 'tshal// bka' sdod mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi dbus// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig chos skyong rnams zhengs shig /ga ya dha ra sku bskyod 'tshal// pho brang mkha' spyod tsā ri nas// bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum la// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// gnas khang 'di la byin gyis rlobs// tshogs gtor 'di la bcud cig phob// 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra ā tsār+ya sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/

oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ shri dz+nya na nā tha dz+nya na ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ karma nā tha karma nā sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ lo ka nā tha lo ka ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ sa ma ya nā tha sa ma ya ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ma hā kā la sing hā mu kha sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes brjod cing rol mo bya/ tshogs kyi phud gtor mar bran/ bdud rtsi nam mkhar 'bul lo// ༈ mchod gtor la bdud rtsi bran la/ oṃ/ ma dag snod bcud stong par sbyangs// stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi// rlung me thod sgyed steng nyid du// thod par sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// rlung mes bskol ba'i dam tshig pa'i// bdud rtsi rab 'bar 'od nyid des// ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas// dbyer med oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ gis// byin rlabs dri ro mtshungs med gyur// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs spyan drangs// mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin bzhin gtibs par gyur// yi dam kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// chos skyong kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchod// khyad par chos skyong ber gyi na bza' can// dpal ldan lha mo rang byung rgyal mo ni// mched lcam 'khor dang bcas la mchod par bgyi// rgyal po rnam mang thos sras sngags kyi bdag /rdo rje legs pa srin mgon zhing skyong dang*// mkhar nag rdo rje rgyal po sogs pa'i// karma pa yi bstan pa skyong rnams la// zag med sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga mchog gi /gtor ma rtsa brgyad pañtsa a mṛ ta// dza gad rak+ta'i yon chab mchod par bzhes// 'dod yon lnga dang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*// de kho na yi kun bzang mchod pas mchod// khyod kyi skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa'i de'i// gnas tshul ji bzhin rtogs pa'i sgo gsum gyi// bstod pa ma lus pa yis bstod par bgyi// khyod la 'dod don gsol ba btab pa ni// bdag sogs kun la mchog dang thun mong gi

/dngos grub stan thog 'di la stsol ba dang*// khyad par tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas// yid la bsam tshad skad cig tsam nyid la// grub nas karma pa yi bzhed pa kun// bdag gis ma lus myur du 'grub pa dang*// karma pa yi bstan la gnod byed rnams// bdag gis thal ba bzhin du rlog pa yi// nus pa da lta nyid du stsal du gsol// de ltar mchod bstod dad pa'i dge ba des// ma gyur 'gro ba sems can thams cad kun// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa 'di ni rin chen dpal mos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rje btsun karma pa mi bskyod rdo rjes gsungs pa'o// ༈ hūm̐/ bstan srung mthar thug rdo rje ber can dang*// yum chen dpal ldan lha mo rang byung ma// nag po yab yum phyogs bcu'i mgon po dang*// dregs pa don gnyis bdud btsan klu yi mgon// rnam sras sngags bdag skyes bu rdo rje legs// srin mgon zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu dang*// ma bdun sring bzhi 'bar ma dgu rnams dang*// dus bzhi'i lha mo dmag gi rgyal mo bzhi// dbang phyug nyer brgyad brtan ma bcu gnyis dang*// mkhar nag rdor rgyal bkra shis tshe ring sogs// lha klu gzhi bdag mthu bo che rnams dang*// pho nya las mkhan bsam yas grangs 'das la// mnyes rdzas drag po'i gta' gtor chen po dang*// sman dang rak+ta gser dngul dar zab sogs// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod rdzas 'bul// dgyes par bzhes la ci bsam phrin las sgrubs// ces pa'ang karma pa bcu bzhi pas kha sab bgyis pa'o// ༈ /bskang rdzas mchod gtor rnams la bdud rtsi bran te/ daṃ ṣ+ṭot+ka ṭas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i mgo bo'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu zhing*/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa'i gtor ma rnams dang*/

hūm̐ yig nag po dpag tu med pa las byung ba'i sgrub pa'i rdzas/ mchod pa'i rdzas/ bskang ba'i rdzas/ bsten pa'i rdzas la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā maṃ sa āḥhūm̐/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ ba su ta/ mañtsa me tsi/ go ro tsa na/ a mṛ ta/ su ra ta/ ba liṃ ta/ kiṃ ni ri ti/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlab tai/ hūm̐/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*// yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// dpa' mo rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*// ye shes mgon po'i= las kyi mgon po'i= 'jig rten mgon po'i= sras mchog nag po'i= dpal ldan lha mo'i= dbugs len yab yum= phyogs bcu mgon po'i= dregs pa don gnyis= dregs pa rnam gsum= ma mo bdun gyi= sring mo bzhi yi= 'bar ma dgu yi= dus bzhi lha mo'i= dmag gi rgyal mo'i= dbang phyug nyer brgyad= brtan ma bcu gnyis= sprul dang yang sprul= dam can rgya mtsho'i= thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// chags che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol// phyi nang bar chad bzlog tu gsol// phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub tu gsol// dkyil 'khor gnyen po dral la re// nyes byed sdebs su shol la re// bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// rdo rje slob dpon slob mar bcas// rdo rje mched dang lcam dral dang*// rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la// mi la nad yams ma btang zhig /phyugs la god yams ma btang zhig /nor la gya gram ma btang zhig /zhing la rtsa sad ma btang zhig /bdud kyi zhags pa nag po chod// gshin rje'i khram kha dgra la sgyur// mi mthun bar chad rkyen rnams zlog /'khor rnams srung la rkyen rnams zlog /sdang ba'i dgra la rtags byung zhig /gnod pa'i bgegs la las mdzod cig

/'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang*// bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod// thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis// khro bo'i drag shul bzlog tu gsol// he ru ka yi gzi brjid zlog /phur pa'i byad ka bzlog tu gsol// stobs po che yi zil gnon zlog /lha rnams kun gyi rtsub rims zlog /lha min rnams kyi dug gzer zlog /gza' chen brgyad kyi gzer 'debs zlog /gshin rje'i pho mo'i 'khrul 'khor zlog /bdud dmag rnams kun khram kha zlog /ma mo rnams kyi thun zor zlog /klu chen rnams kyi 'ching ba zlog /gnod sbyin rnams kyi gzer nad zlog /btsan gyi rgyu srang bzlog tu gsol// rgyal po'i dbyings skyo thams cad zlog /mkha' 'gro'i khrag nad bzlog tu gsol// 'byung po yi dwags rims nad zlog /the'u rang 'gong po la sogs pa// dam sri log 'dren bgegs tshogs kyi// phugs kyi sris rkun thams cad zlog /bal mo'i dug mtshon bzlog tu gsol// sngon gyi sgrub brgyud gser ri'i phreng tshogs kyis// ji ltar bka' bsgos tha tshig ma g.yel bar// ye shes mgon po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// dwags brgyud bstan dgra'i cho 'phrul zhi bar mdzod// oṃ ma hā kā la kā li ma hā maṃ sa kha raṃ khā hi/ de bzhin du/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ ba su ta/ mañtsa me tsi/ go ro tsa na/ a mṛ ta/ su ra ta/ ba liṃ ta/ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes pas thugs dam bskang zhing phrin las bcol la/ man ngag gi yig brgya gzungs dang bcas pas nyams chags bshags/ ༈ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pas bstsal ba'i 'khrugs skong bsdus pa ni/ bh+yo/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar thug la// ban+de bla ma'i dam tshig nyams// skye bo khrel dang ngo tsha bor// de tshe ma mo thugs khros nas// nad mug 'khrugs gsum sprin ltar g.yo// de dag khyod kyi cho 'phrul te// de phyir dam rdzas gtor bdud rtsi// brten bskang sgrub pa gsum gyi rdzas// ma mo 'khrugs pa'i thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i mthus// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam 'gro tshogs kyis// nad gdon bar chad bzlog tu gsol// mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog tu gsol// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// bdag gzhan mi shes le lo yis// sa lam bgrod la 'gal ba rnams// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par gsol// 'dzam gling bde ba'i bkra shis shog/

༈ de nas thun gtor 'bul bar spro na/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas sprul pa yang sprul gyi tshogs lcags kyu thogs pa grangs med pa spros nas dgra bo rnams bkug ste gtor mar bstim pas dgra bgegs dngos su gyur bar bsam la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma mchog /brgyud par bcas pa thams cad dang*// lha mi'i ston pa bcom ldan 'das// rnam grol mchog sbyin chos kyi mchog /der gnas rgyal ba'i sras rnams dang*// yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// khyad par dpal ldan nag po che// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden cing*// bden pa chen po'i mthu rtsal gyis// gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs kyi// bla srog rnam shes gar gnas kyang*// rang dbang med par 'dir khug cig /badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ kā la rū pa ni ku ru ā kar+ṣa ya/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ theng ma theng ma hri/ sti ga ye/ u ni u ni la ra dza dza/ mdun bskyed mgon po'i phyag gi gri gug las hūm̐ lha mo'i kha ṭ+wām̐ las dzaḥ'aphros nas sna bug dang gshang lam du zhugs nas snying gar phyin pas zangs lcags kyi 'khor lo gnyis su gyur nas g.yas g.yon du drag tu 'khor bas sha rus dum bur btub par bsam la/ oṃ trag rak+ṣa dun tiṃ ma bh+yo/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la ya/ shā sa naṃ/ u pa kā ri ṇāṃ eṣ+pa pash+tsi ma kā lo yaṃ/ duṃ duṃ rak+ṣa tshal pa ha la duṣ+ṭa sha trūṃ ta thā ru tri pi ta/ dha mi rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇī/ ya ti pra ti dz+nyā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ ma ma duṣ+ṭaṃ dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ de na me ke na/ dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ e ā ral+li hoḥ shrī ma hā kā la khā hi/ traka rak+ṣa khā hi/ traka rak+ṣa dun bh+yo khā hi/ traka rak+ṣa rbad bh+yo khā hi/ dam can mgon po nag po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs su gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di 'bul lo// bzhes su gsol khā hi/

ma ma snying khrag tshal pa dun tiṃ ha la duṃ bh+yo/ gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha khrag la kha raṃ khā hi/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa gsol bar bsam la/ de nas drag tu rbad cing phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ gang zhig bla ma la smod chos la sdang*// 'gro la rnam 'tshe sgrub pa po la gnod// ngan 'gror nyer gzhol de dag rnams kyis srog /zangs gri 'bar bas yud kyis gcod par mdzod// gang du rdo rje ser chen dbab pa'am// bskal me 'bar dang drag po'i rlung shugs sogs// 'jigs chen brgya phrag du ma'i cho 'phrul dang*// ltas ngan mtshan ma bye ba dbab par mdzod// shin tu mi bzad nad gdon 'bum phrag gis// dgra bo bu dang chung ma 'bangs bcas kun// skad cig nyid la bsad de bskal stong du// mnan gzer bskrad dang rengs pa'i phrin las mdzod// mi bsrun sha za'i pho nya dung phyur yang*// khros pa'i mig bgrad khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs// rno ba'i mtshon thogs rngam pa'i nga ro 'byin// rings par rgyug byed khyod kyi dus la bab// nam mkha' gang ba 'dab bzang dbang po'i tshogs// gdong lnga la sogs gcan gzan ma rungs pa// bye ba dung phyur khri phrag du ma rnams// nyams pa 'di yi sha rus khrag la rol// bh+yo/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro mgon skyob pa rnams kyi bka' bzhin du// phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i bka' nyan ma// rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan zhing ma thogs par// phrin las sna tshogs sgrub pa'i las mdzod cig /dper na rngon pas ri dwags bshor ba bzhin// bsod pa don du gnyer ba'i las mdzad mas// bsad pa don du gnyer ba'i las mdzod cig /oṃ e ā ral+li hoḥ shrī ma hā kā la khā hi/ trag rak+ṣa khā hi/ trag rak+ṣa dun bh+yo khā hi/ trag rak+ṣa rbad bh+yo khā hi/ dam can mgon po nag po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs su gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di 'bul lo// bzhes su gsol khā hi/

ces brjod nas thun gtor zor du byed pa'am rang bzhin 'bul ba skabs dang bstun/ ༈ de nas lhag chad la sogs pa dang dam tshig gi nyes ltung bshags shing bzod par gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ don dam chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje'i thabs kyis sprul pa'i skur ston cing*// smon lam dbang gis gdug pa'i tshal 'dzin pa// dpal ldan 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// thog med dus nas ma rig dbang gyur pas// mi shes sgrib pa le lo'i dbang gis ni// thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam las 'gal ba rnams// sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod// da lta bdag blo dman pa'i dbang gyur te// bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin yan lag ma tshang dang*// gsang sngags grangs nyung log par gyur pa rnams// las kyi mgon po'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod// sgo gsum snyom las le lo'i dbang gis ni// dam rdzas ma tshang gtor ma'i phud nyams dang*// 'gal dang nor 'khrul chad lhag gyur pa rnams// 'jig rten pho nya'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod// de ltar gsol ba'i thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// bdag gi nyes pa'i tshogs rnams dag pa dang*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun du bsrung ba dang*// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol/ ༈ bh+yo/ rlung nag dgu klong 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor du// dpal gyi bka' sdod nye ba'i snying nye ma// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob khams gsum bdud 'dul ma// dbang phyug lha mo dpon g.yog bdag la dgongs// 'da' bka' rdo rje dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer// yongs su mi gtong 'da' bar mi bgyid kyang*// klong du ma gyur goms pa'i shugs chung bas// lta ba 'phangs dma' chos nyid don ma rtogs// sgom pa yun thung lha mo'i zhal ma mthong*// snying po grangs nyung grwa chag zur nyams dang*// nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pas gang ba dang*// nyams dang gtam byas kha 'phro bsres pa dang*// khas blangs dam bcas dus las yol ba dang*// dam rdzas ma tshang gtor ma'i phud nyams dang*// sgrub la mi brtson le los g.yengs pa dang*// gsang ba'i man ngag gzhan la spel ba rnams// rab tu 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// mthol lo mthol lo ye shes ma mo'i tshogs// bshags so bshags so 'jig rten pho nya rnams// thugs rje chen pos tshangs par stsal du gsol// oṃ sa ma ya/
